text: dsh-git-commit 是适用于提供 commands 服务的 DSH profile 的斜杠命令插件，通过宿主命令服务注册 /commit。它检查当前会话工作目录是否位于 Git 工作树中，将全部变更暂存，再调用会话当前路由的模型概括暂存差异并生成提交信息，最后执行本地提交并汇报提交摘要和文件变更。也可直接提供自定义提交标题；模型未配置、超时或回复不可用时，会按变更路径生成本地标题后继续提交。适合希望在 DSH 会话中快速整理并提交工作区改动的开发者。需要 Node.js 20 以上版本和 PATH 中的 Git；AI 摘要会使用当前会话模型。

dsh-git-commit adds /commit to DSH profiles with the commands service. It stages workspace changes, asks the session model to summarize them, then creates a local commit and reports changed files. A custom title skips the model; failures use a local fallback. Requires Node.js 20+ and Git.
想让 DSH 根据当前 Git 改动自动写提交说明并提交。
有没有命令能把工作区文件都暂存后一次提交？
Can I create a local Git commit from my DSH session using an AI generated summary of the staged changes?
dsh-git-commit 的「生成并提交」功能：/commit 会暂存工作区所有变更，用当前会话模型总结差异并创建本地提交；也可以传入自定义提交标题。
dsh-git-commit 使用 AI 摘要时会把暂存差异发送给会话当前选用的模型；具体服务取决于该会话的模型路由。传入自定义提交信息则跳过模型调用。

dsh-git-commit README · dsh-git-commit：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that adds one global slash command — **`/commit`**. It stages every change in the session's working directory, asks the model the session is currently using to summarize the staged diff, and commits with that message.

English · [中文说明](#中文说明)

dsh-git-commit README · What it does：1. Verifies the session's working directory is inside a Git work tree, and stops with an explanation when it is not.
2. Stages everything with `git add -A`, untracked files included.
3. Unless you supplied your own message, sends `git diff --cached` to the model the session is using right now and asks for a commit message: a first line in `模块: 描述` form (module and what changed, ≤ 50 characters), then 3–8 `- ` bullets that summarize substantive changes by module or theme instead of listing files.
4. Commits with `git commit -m <title> -m <bullets>`.
5. Reports the short hash, the bullets, and the file list with per-file `+added / -deleted` counts.

dsh-git-commit README · What it does：Two paths skip the model call:

- You pass your own message — `/commit 修正登录超时` uses that text as the title.
- The automatic fallback — when the model route is unset, the call times out, or the reply is unusable, the plugin builds a deterministic Chinese title from the changed paths, commits anyway, and prefixes the output with a warning naming the failure and the route it tried. A model error never leaves your changes staged and uncommitted.

dsh-git-commit README · What it does：The route is resolved from the newest of the session's `model/selection` event and its last `request/header`, so a mid-session model switch is respected rather than the route captured when the agent was created.

What it does **not** do: it never pushes, never creates or switches branches, never amends, and never touches a remote. All it runs is `git add -A` and `git commit` in the session's working directory.

dsh-git-commit README · What it does：It also ships no browser UI. The command is registered host-side through the `commands` service, so it is available in any profile that provides that service — not only `web`.

dsh-git-commit README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:qingyou002/dsh-git-commit
```

`dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm inside the profile directory and then appends the package to `dsh.profile.bundles`, because it declares `dsh.bundle`. The command becomes available in every session of that profile — restart DSH if it was already running.

Development install from a clone:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/qingyou002/dsh-git-commit

dsh-git-commit README · "dsh-git-commit": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-git-commit"：cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web && pnpm install
```

dsh-git-commit README · Usage：```text
/commit                   # the model writes the message
/commit 修复登录超时       # your text becomes the title; no model call
```

Example output:

```text
✅ 已提交 a1b2c3d：后台: 修复令牌过期后未刷新

📝 改动要点
- 令牌过期时改为静默刷新并重试原请求

dsh-git-commit README · Configuration：| Option | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `timeoutMs` | `90000` | Deadline for the summarizing model call, in milliseconds. |
| `maxDiffChars` | `48000` | The staged diff is truncated beyond this many characters — head plus tail with a marked gap — before it is sent. |
| `maxTokens` | `2048` | Token ceiling for the summarizing call. |
| `maxTitleChars` | `100` | Hard cap on the first line; a longer title is cut and suffixed with `...`. |
| `maxBullets` | `12` | Maximum number of bullet lines kept from the reply. |

dsh-git-commit README · Configuration：Override them in your profile patch layer:

```yaml

dsh-git-commit README · ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml：- id: dsh-git-commit
  config:
    timeoutMs: 60000
```

dsh-git-commit README · Requirements：- A DeepSeek Harness build providing `@deepseek-ai/dsh-commands`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-util-values` — declared as `peerDependencies`, tested against `0.1.5-rc.3`.
- Node.js ≥ 20.
- `git` on `PATH`. The plugin shells out to the `git` binary and says so plainly when it is missing.
- A model route configured in the session for AI-written messages; without one the local fallback still commits.

dsh-git-commit README · 中文说明：`/commit` 是全局斜杠命令：把当前会话工作目录里的全部改动 `git add -A` 暂存，用**会话当前正在使用的模型**总结 `git diff --cached`，再按总结结果提交。

- `/commit`：模型生成提交信息，首行为 `模块: 描述`（≤50 字），随后 3~8 条 `- ` 要点，按模块或主题概括实质改动，不逐文件罗列文件名。
- `/commit 你自己写的说明`：直接用你的文字作标题，不调用模型。
- 模型调用失败时（未配置模型路由、超时、输出无法解析）**不会中断提交**：改用本地规则按改动路径生成中文标题正常提交，并在输出开头标注失败原因与尝试过的路由。模型报错不会把你的改动留在「已暂存未提交」状态。
- 只做本地 `git add -A` 与 `git commit`：**不会** push、不会新建或切换分支、不会 amend、不碰远端。
- 不带任何浏览器界面：命令通过 `commands` 服务注册在宿主侧，凡是提供该服务的 profile（不限于 `web`）都能用。

dsh-git-commit README · 中文说明：配置项与默认值：`timeoutMs` 90000、`maxDiffChars` 48000、`maxTokens` 2048、`maxTitleChars` 100、`maxBullets` 12；在 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 里用 `- id: dsh-git-commit` 加 `config:` 覆盖。

安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:qingyou002/dsh-git-commit
```
